text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And now, summer camp comes to a
close...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I'm never going to whine or complain
again,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I swear upon this very ocean! I'm not
going to
hang my head even once during
the fall of my
classic year!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'm going to keep my eyes on the prize and move forward! So make sure you keep your eyes on me too!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With a firm expression on her face,
Kitasan Black
stands tall as she stares
out at the ocean. Just
then...
choice_data_list_en: Yeah! That's the resolve I like to see!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
That's a pretty stoic expression you have
on
there, Kitasan Black. Did something
happen?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Bakushin O. I just happened to
realize
something important.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Well, to put it simply, I realized I...

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Have to go FULL BAKUSHIN! I guess
that was the
answer all along.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Oooh! So you finally realized it! Yeah,
you're
exactly right!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
You'll be able to make it as long as you
press on
without hesitating! Now let's
charge forward
together!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The other racers' ways of living and the
Bakushin
spirit that Kitasan Black
inherited meld into one.
Only hellbent
dedication will be able to throw
open
the heavy doors of fate.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look forward to witnessing Kitasan
Black's
unwavering determination put
into play this fall.
